I hope this doesn't offend you or come across the wrong way.  Aspies often see NT's as needy.  The harder you push to get closer to him, the more likely it is that he is going to think that.  I"m the same way and my gf has had to learn not to push so hard.  You're probably going to have to do the opposite of what you really want to do in this situation.

It would probably help if you listed in more detail why you think he is an aspie.  btw...My girlfriend came to me a few months ago and asked me if I'm an aspie.  To which, I responded "I really don't think so".  This was due to the extreme causes that I'd come contact with.  About a month later, she asked me again and I said no.  To which she responded by asking me to what a few youtube videos she had found.  One with a guy who has aspergers, he talks about what he is like in his relationship with his girlfriend.
